summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on October 7-8, 2026 attaching Exhibit 99.1, amended Articles dated October 2, 2026, adopted under the Business Corporations Act (British Columbia). The filing is a routine corporate-governance disclosure covering interpretation, share structure, transfers, borrowing powers, shareholder meetings, director elections, advance-notice policy, indemnification and dividends; no transaction, stake, price or board recommendation appears. It maps to a US Form 8-K exhibit filing of amended bylaws. No special-situation or risk-arb angle; only watch for future governance or capital-structure changes enabled by the amended Articles.
